headline: Record profit and margin gains as growth stays broad-based
summary_short: AcadeMedia's Q4 net sales rose 10.6% y/y to SEK 5,658M as adjusted EBITA climbed 16.2% to SEK 552M, capping a full year in which revenue grew 7% to SEK 20.4bn and adjusted EBITA margin hit a record 7.4%.
summary_long: Q4 net sales grew 10.6% y/y (6.0% organic) to SEK 5,658M, with adjusted EBITA up 16.2% to SEK 552M and margin expanding to 9.8% from 9.3%, on high capacity utilisation and cost control across Swedish schools. Full-year adjusted EBITA margin reached 7.4%, within AcadeMedia's 7-8% target range, as earnings grew faster than sales; the Adult Education segment benefited from continued demand for labour-market services and vocational education. Average student count (excluding Adult Education) rose 5.2% to 119,430. Full-year earnings after tax rose 19.2% to SEK 1.1bn and free cash flow grew 14.2% to SEK 1.3bn. This release was preliminary; balance-sheet detail and next-year guidance figures were not disclosed.

drivers.explanation: Reported growth of 10.6% included 6.0% organic growth, with the balance from acquisitions completed during the year (eight in total, seven outside Sweden).
Expansion to 9.8% from 9.3% attributed to high capacity utilisation and good cost control across Swedish schools.
Reached 7.4%, inside the group's 7-8% target range, as earnings grew faster than sales on operating leverage across segments.
Grew 5.2% on continued organic enrollment growth plus contribution from the year's eight acquisitions.
Management described continued strong student growth and stable profitability, with the Adult Education segment citing continued demand for labour-market services and vocational education.
